methodology.actorFirstRule: Fund/advised/co-investment vehicle or non-operating acquisition SPV acting as principal is DIRECT_FUND; an already-owned operating company acting without a directly transacting fund vehicle is PORTFOLIO_COMPANY.
methodology.mixedRule: Actual mixed direct/portfolio transactions count once as Direct and require independent second review.
methodology.evidenceRule: Sponsor branding is lineage only. Each proposed acting entity must be supported by transaction-and-party evidence; Portfolio classifications also require date-valid ownership evidence.
methodology.approvalCaveat: This is an independent research proposal, not a human approval or evidence-open attestation.
